name: Sanctions & coercion
value: EU preparing Iran cyber sanctions (16 Nov)
summary: EU ministers backed further action on Iran over supermarket cyberattacks on 16 Nov; no package formally adopted yet
state: At the Foreign Affairs Council on 16 Nov, Kaja Kallas said the EU is preparing further sanctions on Iran after cyberattacks on French supermarket refrigeration systems, saying the threat from Iran increasingly extends to Europe (Middle East Eye). Ministers supported further action but no package was formally adopted; at least 11 other European countries were hit by similar attacks in early November (The Copenhagen Post). No major economy cut off from payment systems or large seizure of sovereign assets was found as of 17 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Firms trading with Iran, or running internet-connected refrigeration and building-control systems, are most exposed. UK businesses can check current sanctions lists and OFSI guidance on GOV.UK.
rubric_hit: Watch: major new package in preparation — EU Iran cyber sanctions announced 16 Nov; no payment cut-off or asset seizure
